title: Stonier Fire & Wine Winter Lunch
summary: Stonier's annual winter party. Food cooked over coals, new release Stonier wines, fires lit, live music, masterclasses and tours through the day. Sells out fast.
priceRange: TBC (discounted for KBS Wine Club members)
accessibilityNotes: Check with venue for access needs
weatherDependency: Outdoor fires; some indoor shelter; early August weather can be cool and changeable
nearbyAttractions: Paringa Estate; Merricks General Wine Store; Balnarring Village
suggestedItineraryPairing: Pair with a Red Hill accommodation stay; visit Merricks General Store for the next day
kidsGradeNote: Adult-only winter party with serious wine pours and open fires.
editorVerdict: Sit-down winter lunch in a working vineyard with proper chefs at the fire. Book it once and you'll book it again.
editorNote:
Stonier's annual winter party luncheon. Food cooked over coals, new release Stonier wines on every table, fires lit through the property, live music, masterclasses and short vineyard tours running across the day. Past chefs have been MoVida and Farmer's Daughters; the 2026 line-up isn't announced yet.

The KBS Wine Club gets the early-bird ticket release and the discount. The general release tickets sell out within days, so set a reminder for the Stonier email and Instagram drop in late June.

Dress warm and bring a coat for the walk between the fires and the cellar door. Stay overnight in Red Hill or Merricks and make the Merricks General Store breakfast the next morning.
